SELECT ja.id, ja.candidate_id, r.file_name AS resume_file_name, ja.ai_match_score, ja.status, ja.created_at FROM job_applications ja LEFT JOIN resumes r ON r.id = ja.resume_id WHERE ja.is_deleted = false AND ja.job_id = #{jobId} AND ja.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}
AND ja.status = #{status}

SELECT ja.job_id, ja.candidate_id, r.id AS resume_id, r.file_name AS resume_file_name, ja.ai_match_score, ja.status, ja.created_at, ja.updated_at FROM job_applications ja join resumes r ON ja.resume_id = r.id WHERE ja.is_deleted = false AND ja.id = #{applicationId} AND ja.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}

SELECT ja.id, ja.job_id, ja.enterprise_id, j.title AS job_title, ja.ai_match_score, ja.status, ja.created_at FROM job_applications ja JOIN jobs j ON ja.job_id = j.id WHERE ja.candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND ja.is_deleted = false
AND ja.status = #{status}
